system.description:
You can retreat from enemies with additional speed and agility.

Prerequisites: Droid; Hovering, Flying, Wheeled, or Tracked Locomotion; Dexterity 13

Effect: When using the Withdraw Action, you can move up to 2 squares to escape Threatened squares without provoking an Attack of Opportunity, and you can move your Speed. You can spend a Force Point as a Reaction to an enemy ending its movement adjacent to you to Withdraw.

Normal: When using the Withdraw Action, you can normally move only 1 square to escape a Threatened square without provoking an Attack of Opportunity and can move only up to half your Speed.

Special: You must be equipped with Hovering, Flying, Wheeled, or Tracked Locomotion to use this Feat.
